text:
This marks our third direct test between Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0.

This time, we pushed both models into the fantasy, massive creatures, and fully dialogue-driven animal characters. From cinematic monster reveals to fantasy and talking animal scenes.

Every single shot was generated using:
• The exact same base image
• The exact same prompt
• No re-generate

Pure output. No retries. No cherry-picking.
What do you think?

Seedance 2.0 Generated by @rzanggarda on @BytePlusGlobal
content:
Use the exact same base image and the exact same prompt across Seedance 2.0 shots to run a fair, consistent comparison test against another model’s raw output.
Generate each shot with no re-generate (no retries/cherry-picking) to evaluate Seedance 2.0’s first-pass output quality.

extra_content.quoted_text:
WOUNDS | AI Short Film

In this short film WOUNDS, I wanted to see how far @Kling_ai  3.0 could really deliver raw human emotion. I pushed it hard, silence, tears, shaky moments, broken voices.
 And honestly… I’m kind of amazed by how much emotion it managed to hold in these shots.
Now I’m curious, did you feel it too? Did the emotion come through for you while watching this scene?

--- TWEET CITADO ---
WOUNDS | Cortometraje de IA

En este cortometraje WOUNDS, quería ver hasta qué punto @Kling_ai 3.0 podía realmente transmitir emoción humana en bruto. Lo llevé al límite, silencio, lágrimas, momentos de temblor, voces quebradas.

Ahora tengo curiosidad, ¿tú también lo sentiste? ¿La emoción te llegó mientras veías esta escena?
